quote.text: Honor and revere the gods, treat human beings as they deserve, be tolerant with others and strict with yourself. Remember, nothing belongs to you but your flesh and blood—and nothing else is under your control.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Lead by example: uphold self-discipline and strive for personal excellence while showing compassion; in doing so, you instill in your children the values of integrity and responsibility.
    • Embrace the truth that while you can nurture and protect your family—your flesh and blood—many external factors remain beyond your control; accept and guide these uncertainties with calmness and wisdom.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, honor and respect the inherent worth of every individual; by being tolerant with others and strict with yourself, you foster a culture of accountability and mutual respect.
    • Recognize that while you can influence and inspire your team, the outcomes may not entirely rest in your hands; focus on setting a righteous example and temper your expectations with a steady mind.
  • Product Management
    • In managing products, distinguish between what is within your control—your actions and decisions—and what is not, such as market forces; this clear-eyed perspective can streamline effective decision-making.
    • Treat stakeholders and team members with fairness and respect, just as you value your own efforts; maintain strict standards for personal accountability while remaining flexible and tolerant in the face of external changes.
